title: coder completion
description: The coder's exit. It does not decide when the chapter is done — the driver stops it once the writer reports ready_for_review, because a participant in a loop must not be its terminator.

outcome.description: Only one branch: the coder stops when asked, never on its own judgement.

snippets_written.description: Paths written under snippets/. The coder only ever CREATES files, so nothing is edited concurrently.
